decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to utilize the "Living End" card to create a powerful combo that allows the player to destroy all creatures on the battlefield and then bring back a large number of creatures from the graveyard. This combo is achieved by cycling cards like Curator of Mysteries, Striped Riverwinder, and Street Wraith to fill up the graveyard, and then casting Living End to bring them all back. The deck includes various cycling creatures and cards to ensure a smooth cycle of cards and efficient execution of the combo.

The key concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive playstyle using a combination of creatures and spells. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides an additional advantage. The deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Orcish Bowmasters to deal damage quickly. It also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to ensure efficient resource utilization. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a blend of speed, power, and disruption.

This deck aims to quickly flood the board with powerful creature tokens by utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast free spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to control the game in its favor. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent while also having access to versatile removal spells like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to all the colors needed for the deck's spells.

The deck focuses on using "Cascade" spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to quickly put pressure on the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant. It also includes disruptive spells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and spell-based disruption, creating a challenging board state that can be difficult for the opponent to deal with effectively.

The deck focuses on using powerful control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to slow down opponents while ramping up mana with Omnath, Locus of Creation and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Delighted Halfling and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional removal options, while Wrenn and Six offer card advantage and land recursion. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements, with fetch lands and shock lands providing consistency.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures and casting spells that enable a quick and powerful combo finish with Living End, bringing all cycled creatures back onto the battlefield at once. The deck runs multiple ways to cycle creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan, with the goal of overwhelming them with a large board of creatures after resolving Living End. The deck also includes some control elements with Force of Negation to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' plays.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, backed up by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, while using cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to generate additional value from creatures. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base and Orcish Bowmasters to deal with flying threats.

The deck focuses on using strong control elements like counterspells and removal spells to protect and support the powerful card, The One Ring. By controlling the game and limiting the opponent's options, the deck aims to dominate the board and overwhelm the opponent with its strong creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Murktide Regent. The key strategy is to establish a strong presence on the battlefield while ensuring that The One Ring remains intact to provide a powerful advantage over the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and lands with powerful abilities to quickly assemble a strong board state. The key strategy involves utilizing the untap abilities of lands like Simic Growth Chamber and bounce lands to generate multiple land drops per turn, allowing for explosive plays and the ability to search for the necessary key pieces with cards like Urza's Saga and Expedition Map. By efficiently ramping into powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and leveraging their abilities, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through its combo potential.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells while utilizing the Cascade mechanic to generate additional value. By playing cards with converted mana costs of 3 or less, the deck aims to consistently cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed. The deck also includes a mix of counter spells and removal to control the board and protect its threats. Overall, the strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cascaded spells and efficient interaction.

This deck utilizes aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage, while Underworld Breach allows for graveyard recursion. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and additional mana ramp. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total with big creatures and efficient spells, while maintaining card advantage and flexibility in its gameplay.

This deck leverages equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly set up a powerful combo that can deal massive damage in just a few turns. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip these powerful artifacts, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with large, evasive creatures. With the support of cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt opponents' strategies while assembling its combo pieces for a decisive victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that provide quick and efficient aggression to overwhelm opponents. By combining powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with versatile removal cards like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, it creates a fast-paced playstyle that aims to end the game as quickly as possible. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Wrenn and Six provide additional value and consistency to ensure that the deck remains competitive throughout the match.

This aggro Jund deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. It also includes artifact hate with Nihil Spellbomb and Mishra's Bauble, as well as land recursion with Wrenn and Six. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early while disrupting their game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of threats and disruption. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also utilizes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to control the board and maintain a fast-paced, aggressive strategy. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate, as well as some graveyard recursion effects like Feign Death and Undying Malice, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively use The Underworld Cookbook to discard cards and cheat out big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Cragganwick Cremator. The deck also includes cards like Profane Tutor and Thoughtseize to search for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to unleash devastating blows and control the game's tempo.
